title: The great sling in play (D-129, D-131): GS2 in every take, packed on its wagon while it moves; the frogs' bullfrog leaper (FS1 A), packed on its sledge and as it throws
_doc: The great sling as the game draws it (siege_models.gd _great_sling, _great_packed): six haulers in two files by the pull ropes, a loader at the stones; a centaur crew hauls two abreast further out. The frogs' (D-131, FS1 A: _frog_sling, _frog_packed): the bullfrog on its reed tower over the counterweight sling, a loader, two haulers on the re-cocking rope, a tower minder; the sledge the bullfrog hauls while it moves; the throw (the bullfrog landed on the pad, the arm swung through) shown for a moment after each shot.
